english.title: Disqualified person obtaining a driving licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), while disqualified for holding or obtaining a driving licence, obtained a driving licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 103(1)(a)of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) The above does not apply in relation to disqualification by virtue of section 101 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 (disqualification by reason of age).
